methodology.weight_memory: Nominal parameter count × bits per stored weight, plus an explicit editable metadata overhead. Nominal family sizes are approximate rather than exact serialized tensor counts.
methodology.kv_cache: Standard decoder-only attention approximation: layers × 2 (K,V) × KV heads × head dimension × KV bytes × tokens × concurrent sequences.
methodology.sharding: Capacity outputs assume ideal even sharding of both model weights and KV cache across the configured devices. Actual serving frameworks, pipeline parallelism, replicas and hybrid attention can differ.

presets.label: Llama 3.1 8B
presets.note_es: El tamaño 8B es la denominación nominal de la familia. La memoria de pesos es una estimación, no el tamaño exacto de un checkpoint concreto.
presets.note_en: 8B is the family's nominal size. Weight memory is an estimate, not the exact serialized size of a specific checkpoint.

presets.label: Llama 3.1 70B
presets.note_es: El tamaño 70B es nominal. La arquitectura usa GQA con 8 cabezas KV frente a 64 cabezas de atención.
presets.note_en: 70B is a nominal family size. The architecture uses GQA with 8 KV heads versus 64 attention heads.

presets.label: Llama 3.1 405B · MP8
presets.note_es: Geometría BF16 MP8 publicada por Meta: 128 cabezas de atención y 8 cabezas KV. El tamaño 405B sigue siendo nominal.
presets.note_en: Meta's published BF16 MP8 geometry: 128 attention heads and 8 KV heads. The 405B parameter count remains nominal.

presets.label: Llama 3.1 405B · MP16
presets.note_es: Geometría BF16 MP16 publicada por Meta: 128 cabezas de atención y 16 cabezas KV. La KV cache resultante es mayor que en la variante MP8.
presets.note_en: Meta's published BF16 MP16 geometry: 128 attention heads and 16 KV heads. Its KV cache is therefore larger than the MP8 variant.
